purpose: Albion English decorative UI design concepts

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity DESIGN CONCEPT image based on the attached Albion Android app screenshots. This is concept 01, "THE OXFORD EDITION". Evolve their decorative visual layer into a distinctly English, aristocratic, restrained luxury interface.

Deliver one polished landscape presentation board containing THREE large flat Android screen designs side by side, fully visible, straight on, no physical phones or perspective: HOME, VOCABULARY EXERCISE, READING. The decorations must live INSIDE the actual app screens, not as props around them. Preserve usable modern daily learning UI, spacious readable content, the Albion brand and structure of the references. Screens occupy almost the entire board, small heading above "01 / THE OXFORD EDITION". No explanatory paragraphs on the board.

Art direction: English university library, fine copperplate architectural engraving, Oxford college spires, subtle letterpress impression, antique bookplates. Add a light engraved college facade vignette at the right of the home greeting and a delicate spire illustration in the header background, clearly visible but confined to empty space. Put narrow printer's ornamental rules on the outer screen margins, small laurel sprigs around an academic progress seal, miniature engraved open-book vignettes on section headers, a small ex-libris bookplate above a reading chapter, tasteful ornamental paragraph dividers and a very faint heraldic watermark at the far lower page edge. Use several DIFFERENT well-designed ornaments, with visual restraint. A visible substantial decorative enrichment compared to the supplied screenshots. The white space of the actual exercise remains clean; place a small quill-and-book engraving below its answer area and a fine editorial border around the flashcard. Every ornament should look like an original high quality 19th-century book engraving, not emoji or generic clipart.

Mandatory palette: Ivory #F6F1E7 background, Crimson #861F39 primary blocks and CTA, Antique Gold #C6A66D fine details, Charcoal #24272B text. Subtle ivory laid-paper texture. No added blue or bright green. Typography: Adobe Caslon Pro appearance for "Albion", English titles and quotes; Cormorant Garamond for Russian titles; Inter for controls, exercises and IPA; Literata for reading prose. Hairline icons, small corner radii, fine double keylines used sparingly.
Home copy: "Albion", "Good evening.", "Время для английского", "5", "10", "20", "Начать · 10 ответов", "Ваш маршрут". Bottom navigation labels: "Карточки", "Учебник", "Чтение", "Практика", "Прогресс".
Exercise copy: "abroad", "/əˈbrɔːd/", "За границу", "Показать ответ".
Reading copy: "Chapter 6. The Light", and a short beautifully typeset English passage about a lighthouse.
Avoid ornament over text, cramped layouts, giant coats of arms, royal portraits, cartoon mascots, overly ornate baroque frames, photographic backgrounds, device mockups, outside-the-screen flowers. This must look implementable as a real Android app.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a second distinct decorative design direction for the Albion Android English learning app, using the attached screenshots as the existing UI reference. Concept 02: "LONDON CORRESPONDENCE".

Output one polished landscape design presentation board with THREE very large straight-on flat mobile UI screens side by side, fully visible, no device shells or perspective. Small restrained title above "02 / LONDON CORRESPONDENCE". The screens are HOME, LEARNING ROUTE, READING LIBRARY. All decorative elements must appear WITHIN screen boundaries as functioning app visual details, not props on the board. Preserve the calm daily learning functionality and modern accessible Android structure.

Art direction: elegant London literary journal meets Victorian correspondence and fine contemporary wayfinding. Distinctly architectural and urban, NOT floral, NOT medieval or Oxford. Add a wonderfully detailed but light charcoal-and-gold etched London skyline header showing Elizabeth Tower and a graceful Thames embankment, occupying clear empty space at the home header. Add small original vintage-style postage-stamp panels with perforated edges for "WORD OF THE DAY" and "B1", a curved postal cancellation line as a quiet background flourish at one edge, a narrow vertical railway-timetable rule down the outside margin, understated clock-dial progress details, a tiny brass compass rose in the route screen corner, and a route connecting lesson checkpoints drawn like a refined historical transit map. Represent the river as a delicate warm-grey winding line in an empty background region. A reading library screen with numbered book spines, small engraved streetlamp or Georgian doorway vignettes near section headings and a ticket-like "CONTINUE READING" card. Integrate multiple DIFFERENT English decorative UI details, visibly richer than the original screenshots. Use original artwork; don't reproduce a transport authority logo. A subtle embossed envelope flap motif at the bottom of the daily ritual card is welcome, no cartoon mail.

Palette MUST remain Ivory #F6F1E7, Crimson #861F39, Antique Gold #C6A66D, Charcoal #24272B, with only diluted tints of these. Background is softly textured ivory paper. Strict contemporary grid, thin rules and delicate keylines, small corners. Keep contrast strong. English brand and English display titles in Adobe Caslon Pro style. Russian display titles in Cormorant Garamond style. All small controls, numbers, descriptions, exercise text and navigation are visibly clean modern sans serif INTER, never serif; prose in books Literata.
Home text: "Albion", "Good evening.", "Время для английского", "5", "10", "20", "Начать · 10 ответов", "Word of the day", "journey".
Route text: "Ваш маршрут", "A1", "A2", "B1", "B2", "C1", "Продолжить".
Library text: "Библиотека", "The Keeper of Gull Island", "Продолжить чтение".
Bottom nav on all screens: "Карточки", "Учебник", "Чтение", "Практика", "Прогресс".
Avoid a tourist souvenir aesthetic, Union Jack wallpaper, red buses or phoneboxes as giant mascots, photographs, big black silhouettes behind text, blue, decorative lettering on controls, clutter, generic floating marketing cards. Sophisticated, British, original and implementable.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create concept 03 for the supplied Albion Android language learning app screenshots: "THE ENGLISH GARDEN". This is a new visual direction for the decoration INSIDE the app, using the existing brand and screens as structural references.

One beautiful landscape presentation board, THREE large fully visible straight-on flat Android screens side by side: HOME, GRAMMAR LESSON, VOCABULARY. Small refined board heading "03 / THE ENGLISH GARDEN". No physical phones, no perspective, no decorative props outside the screen designs. This is not a garden app: it remains an English-learning app.

Art direction: English country-house library, refined original Arts and Crafts printmaking, an old botanical edition. Carefully composed monochrome engraved English rose, oak leaves, hawthorn and honeysuckle. Use a visible elegant vertical vine running up each outermost screen edge, only 10–18 logical pixels wide in most areas. Introduce beautifully drawn botanical corner pieces on the home hero block, with a single larger botanical engraving in the unused top right header area. A tasteful faint trellis geometric pattern in an empty side gutter, an antique-gold rose roundel for a daily streak, leaf-shaped gold divider ornaments, a small botanical bookplate under the Albion masthead, and a pressed-leaf style margin bookmark. The grammar page should have a graceful oversize initial capital and a small plant engraving marking a chapter end; the actual rules and English examples stay clean on uninterrupted ivory. On the vocabulary screen frame the card with a fine DOUBLE RULE interrupted by small engraved rosebuds at the corners, with small level tags like botanical specimen labels. All floral artwork is intricate fine-line ink engraving or elegant two-colour woodcut, NOT photographic, NOT clipart, not a bright floral wallpaper. More decorative detail than the reference, yet very readable.

Palette STRICT: Ivory #F6F1E7 dominant, Crimson #861F39 principal actions and occasional rose petals, Antique Gold #C6A66D ornaments, Charcoal #24272B text and engraved linework. Use desaturated diluted tints of these FOUR colours only. NO green leaves: leaves are charcoal/gold linework on ivory. Subtle high-quality book-paper texture. Keep broad clear text columns, generous spacing, thin outlined icons, small button corner radii.
Typography: Adobe Caslon Pro appearance for Albion and English display text; Cormorant Garamond for Russian large headings; visibly clean modern sans serif Inter for all controls, descriptions, IPA and exercises; Literata for the grammar reading body. No decorative serif control text.
Home exact text: "Albion", "Good morning.", "Время для английского", "5", "10", "20", "Начать · 10 ответов", "Ваш маршрут".
Grammar exact title: "Структура английского предложения". Body can show "The cat catches the mouse." and a short Russian explanation, neatly typeset, clean and highly legible. Mark level "A1".
Vocabulary exact text: "blossom", "/ˈblɒsəm/", "Цветение", "Показать ответ".
Bottom navigation on the three screens: "Карточки", "Учебник", "Чтение", "Практика", "Прогресс".
Avoid pink or green colour schemes, cottagecore clutter, flowers behind body text, baroque gilding, crowns everywhere, giant wreaths, photographic material, fantasy UI, ornaments on top of buttons. The result should be an elegant contemporary Android product with an unmistakable English decorative vocabulary.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate concept 04 for the Albion Android English-learning app, based on the supplied actual screenshots: "ST JAMES'S CLUB". Evolve the decorative layer into a quiet aristocratic English club library at evening. This concept must be visually distinct from light botanical or London postcard designs.

Deliver one landscape concept board showing THREE large fully visible flat Android screen designs side by side, straight-on, no physical phones or perspective: HOME, PERSONAL LIBRARY, PROGRESS. Dark theme on all three screens. Small cream/gold board title "04 / ST JAMES'S CLUB". Decorations must be integrated INSIDE the app screens as UI background and margin elements. No room photography, desks, candles or books as external props.

Palette ONLY Charcoal #24272B for main background, Ivory #F6F1E7 for text and light controls, Crimson #861F39 for primary action panels, Antique Gold #C6A66D for fine decoration, plus close diluted tints. Dark graphite surfaces. Typography is prominent and sophisticated: Adobe Caslon Pro style for Albion, English headings and short italic quotes; Cormorant Garamond for Russian large titles; highly legible clean INTER sans serif for all controls, metrics, IPA, small descriptions and navigation; Literata for any reading excerpts. Use subtle dark woven-bookcloth texture in the background, NOT shiny gradients.

Decorative design language: original English heraldic bookplate and engraved club stationery, slender Georgian architectural linework, restrained gilt tooling. At the home header include a beautifully engraved low-contrast Georgian library doorway or panelled bookcase arch in the right-hand empty background, clearly visible as an illustration. A very fine vertically repeated geometric border down the left margin reminiscent of gilt book-spine tooling; refined ornamental corner tools on the crimson daily ritual panel; a tiny original heraldic shield with the Caslon "A", two oak leaves and a small rampant lion engraving, as a seal for learning streak. One small printed crimson wax-seal motif is permitted as a section ornament, not as a floating physical object. Gold hairline folio numbers, engraved compass dots, ribbon-like bookmark tabs on book covers, miniature heraldic lozenges separating sections, an open book small vignette beside the library heading. A short low-contrast lion engraving may sit on the lower unused margin but never behind text. On PROGRESS, add an original circular achievement medallion using fine engraved linework, gold calendar pinpoints, a restrained laurel arc and a distinctive horizontal heraldic divider. Several different decorative UI details, visible yet measured. Not generic empty dark UI.

Keep home structure recognisably Albion: brand masthead, "Good evening.", crimson hero with "Время для английского", answer selectors "5", "10", "20", ivory button "Начать · 10 ответов", followed by learning progress and reading continuation.
Library heading "Библиотека", elegant fine double-frame book covers with Caslon titles "The Keeper of Gull Island" and "A Room in Bloomsbury", button "Продолжить чтение".
Progress heading "Ваш прогресс", sober metrics "12" "дней подряд", "86%" "точность", a clean 30-day activity grid and "A little, every day." italic footer.
Bottom nav: "Карточки", "Учебник", "Чтение", "Практика", "Прогресс".
All touch targets and readable areas remain practical, large and modern. Avoid flashy metallic 3D effects, overwhelming baroque curls, huge royal coats of arms, royal portraits, skulls, military motifs, blue or green, gold body text everywhere, icons as giant mascots, dense ornamental wallpaper. Show an implementable contemporary English-learning product with beautiful detailed decorative framing.
